title: Weekly weather records — 10 pilot districts
description: Weekly weather variables per district: rainfall, temperature, humidity, soil moisture, wind speed, plus a 4-week cumulative rainfall sum and a rainfall anomaly.
source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5/ERA5-Land), district centroid coordinates
license: Open-Meteo data is open access; internal pilot use
quality_summary: 1,050 records (10 districts x 105 weeks). Passes dq_checks.check_ingestion: required columns present, dates parse and fall on Mondays, no duplicate (district_id, week_start), no infinite values, rainfall_cum4wk_mm matches rolling 4-week sum with exactly 3 warm-up NaNs per district.
bias_and_coverage_notes: Reanalysis-derived, so spatially gap-free even for districts without a nearby ZMS station; coarser resolution than a ground station network. Intended as a gap-filler alongside ZMS data, not a replacement for it.
contact_or_steward: Tamiriraishe Tekede, Lead Innovator, BioData Zimbabwe

title: Weekly malaria surveillance — synthetic pilot stand-in
description: Weekly confirmed/suspected cases, deaths, tests performed, test positivity, and case-based lag/moving-average features per district. This file is a synthetic stand-in generated to exercise the pipeline and schema ahead of real MoHCC IDSR/DHIS2 data access.
source: Synthetic generator (pilot placeholder); real source per the proposal is MoHCC IDSR/DHIS2 (SRC-01) and NMCP (SRC-02)
license: Synthetic data, internal pilot use only — not for release
data_sensitivity: public (synthetic; no real patient or facility data)
quality_summary: 1,050 records. NOTE: replace with real IDSR/DHIS2 extract before final handover; synthetic values are illustrative only and must not be presented as real surveillance figures.
bias_and_coverage_notes: Synthetic generation does not yet model real reporting gaps, facility-level underreporting, or cross-border/migrant undercounts described in the proposal's known-limitations section.
contact_or_steward: Tamiriraishe Tekede, Lead Innovator, BioData Zimbabwe

title: Lagged weather features — long/tidy format
description: One row per (district, week, base weather variable, lag) with the base variable's value from that many weeks earlier. Long/tidy format chosen over a fixed wide schema so it pivots cleanly into any ML feature matrix.
source: Derived from weather_records via Stage 2a of the pipeline
quality_summary: 45,211 rows (9 base variables x 5 lags x districts x available weeks, less warm-up). Passes dq_checks.check_lagged_long: expected columns present, base_variable values restricted to the 9 weather fields, lag_weeks restricted to {1,2,4,6,8}, no duplicate (district_id, week_start, base_variable, lag_weeks).
bias_and_coverage_notes: Row count per (district, variable, lag) is exactly max(n_weeks - lag - warmup, 0); shorter district histories yield fewer early lagged rows, which is expected and not a data-quality defect.
contact_or_steward: Tamiriraishe Tekede, Lead Innovator, BioData Zimbabwe

title: Lagged weather features — wide/pivoted format
description: The long lagged-features table pivoted to one column per (base_variable, lag) pair — 45 feature columns plus district_id and week_start. Generated as a convenience feature matrix for direct model input; the long format remains the canonical stored representation.
source: Derived from weather_lagged_features_long via Stage 2b of the pipeline
quality_summary: 1,040 rows x 47 columns. Passes dq_checks.check_lagged_wide: expected columns present, no duplicate (district_id, week_start), row count consistent with the long file's distinct keys.
bias_and_coverage_notes: Cells are null wherever a given district/week doesn't have enough history for that lag; this is expected near the start of each district's series, not a missingness defect.
contact_or_steward: Tamiriraishe Tekede, Lead Innovator, BioData Zimbabwe

title: Merged model-ready outbreak dataset
description: Inner join of weather_records, weather_lagged_features_wide, and malaria_surveillance on (district_id, week_start) — the single feature-and-label table intended for early-warning model training and evaluation. Not yet listed in the proposal's Section 3.1 schema table; should be added there as an eleventh linked table.
source: Derived (merge) from weather_records, weather_lagged_features_wide, and malaria_surveillance
data_sensitivity: public (aggregate; surveillance columns are synthetic in this pilot bundle)
quality_summary: 1,050 rows x 66 columns pre-merge; rows with a null confirmed_cases are dropped after the join. Passes dq_checks.check_merge: no duplicate (district_id, week_start), no overlapping non-key columns between inputs, weather columns in the merged table match their source values.
bias_and_coverage_notes: Inherits every bias/coverage caveat of its three source tables above, most importantly that malaria_surveillance is currently synthetic.
contact_or_steward: Tamiriraishe Tekede, Lead Innovator, BioData Zimbabwe
